acceptance_criteria.summary: A repository-owned Postgres+pgvector test-schema bootstrap now creates the base memories schema and current data-layer additions; TestBackfillScriptIntegration passes against a disposable real pgvector database after the bootstrap fixture runs.

Codex adversarial fix pass (commit 'fix(open-brain-fhb): address codex adversarial findings'). Finding #1: hardened the idempotent DROPs in scripts/bootstrap_test_schema.sql so hybrid_search and decay_unused_priorities rebuild cleanly from ANY historical signature. hybrid_search now drops BOTH the legacy 5-arg (TEXT, vector, INTEGER, INTEGER, INTEGER) and the current 8-arg (..., TEXT, JSONB, TEXT) overloads (schema-qualified as public.hybrid_search to match the CREATE); decay_unused_priorities now drops BOTH float widths (INTEGER, REAL = float4 and INTEGER, DOUBLE PRECISION = float8), because FLOAT-with-no-precision is DOUBLE PRECISION, a distinct overload from REAL. Verified against a real pgvector:pg18-bookworm instance that (a) fresh bootstrap works, (b) an injected legacy-overload DB reproduces the 'function hybrid_search(...) is not unique' ambiguity and the hardened bootstrap removes the orphans leaving exactly one overload each, (c) the CREATE-OR-REPLACE return-type trap is avoided by the added 8-arg DROP, (d) TestBackfillScriptIntegration passes and the non-integration suite stays green (1457 passed). Findings #2 and #3: corrected evidence_ledger.json — replaced the '...expected bootstrap columns...' placeholder with the real reproducible column-check SQL, and annotated the non-reproducible runner-container entry, re-verifying its claims from scratch via direct host-to-container connectivity.
